Pushed 30961c5fd6:
- C2: the failure (commit, log path, tail) now goes to stderr whatever the output mode, and the process exits non-zero silently (TypedPayloadEmitted). New test drives a Failure tick through report_failure into the scheduler's routed_failure_error and asserts the SHA, log path and tail.
- TASK-2291: fetch, ancestry and CI read each start only if their own bound still fits the tick budget; otherwise an out-of-time skip. Tested.
- Cosmetic: not-live-source skips are no longer written to ~/.aida/dev-autopromote.log. Tested.
- TASK-2289: a refused child exits 0 (child_exit), so its unit does not show failed. Tested.
- TASK-2290: docs/cli/11-dev.md now covers the refused and out-of-time outcomes.
subject: PR-2850 pushed (STORY-1689)
